title: Pixel editor within game
author: Nightstar31415
selftext:
This might be a very stupid idea to some, but I got tired of AI messing up some animations and pixels. So I asked it to create an in game pixel editor. If I see something I don't like while implementing a new unit, I go to the menu and fetch the unit. There I can edit the pixels I want, and export a json with the edits. I then give it to Astra to import and update the published web version.

I know there are probably more standard ways to export the graphics, fix in a separate tool etc. But this seemed like a smoother workflow for me. Now I promt astra to create a new unit. I enter the game and inspect it. Edits things I don't like and give Astra the updated version.
